concerns.text: Task T029c 'Implement Scalability Analysis' is missing. The spec requires SC-005 (measure computational complexity class O(n), O(n^2), etc.). While T029c is listed in the text, it is marked as [ ] (unchecked) and the logic described (log-log regression) is not explicitly covered by any other *completed* task. T029b only runs experiments; T029c is the only task performing the analysis required by SC-005. If T029c is not implemented, SC-005 is unmet.

Task T008c is marked [ ] (unchecked). This task generates `calibrated_tdp.json` required by T027 (Energy calculation) and T007b. Without T008c, the energy metric in FR-004 and SC-002 cannot be calculated, leaving the requirement unmet.

Task T014e 'Implement validate_distribution.py' is marked [ ] (unchecked). This task is required to validate the dataset distribution (SC-005 context, FR-001 data integrity) before the final gate (T036). Without T014e, the validation step T036 cannot proceed, blocking the dataset readiness for US1.

Task T031b 'Generate final report' is marked [ ] (unchecked). This task is required to produce the final output containing Success Rate Comparison, Cost Comparison, and Complexity Analysis (SC-001, SC-002, SC-005). Without T031b, the project cannot deliver the required results.

Task T027 'Implement metrics.py' is marked [ ] (unchecked). This task calculates energy consumption (FR-004, SC-002). It depends on T008c (TDP) and T005b (CPU logs). Without T027, the energy metric is missing.

Task T029c is listed as 'Implement Scalability Analysis' but the description includes execution logic ('Perform log-log linear regression...'). The task is marked [ ] (unchecked). If this task is intended to be the implementation of the analysis logic, it must be completed. If the analysis logic is missing from the task list entirely, SC-005 is unmet.
